Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The original facility (spelled Shopper's World) is of historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.
